title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Intraday Agent manages queues and schedule adherence
summary: Hold: the briefing says Microsoft has published nothing about the agent's identity, supporting services or processing boundaries, but Microsoft's general Dynamics 365 agent guidance covers Customer Service and Workforce Engagement Management. The roadmap facts and workforce-alerts control are supported; Intraday-specific controls and billing remain undocumented in the searches performed.
